title: Air conditioner control experiment (10 subjects, 4 classes, 25 EEG ch)
description: EEG recordings from 10 healthy participants using a visual P300 (oddball) brain-computer interface to control a home appliance (an air conditioner) with four selectable commands. Data were acquired at 500 Hz from 25 scalp channels, with 50 training and 30 testing blocks per subject. The dataset supports research on ERP-based BCIs and inter-subject transfer learning for home appliance control.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with an actiCHamp (Brain Products) active-electrode system at 500 Hz from 25 channels placed according to the 10-20 system, referenced to linked mastoids. Visual flash stimuli were presented on an LCD display in a 4-class oddball paradigm with a 750 ms stimulus onset asynchrony. Each subject completed 50 training and 30 online testing blocks with visual feedback.
